RANSOMWARE.name: Ransomware / Cryptor
RANSOMWARE.description: Actively encrypts user files at high frequency, alters extensions, deletes shadow copies, and extorts victims.
remediation_playbook: 1. IMMEDIATE ISOLATION: Terminate the offending process tree immediately (kill -9 <PID> / taskkill /F /T /PID <PID>).
2. NETWORK CUT: Sever all network interfaces (Wi-Fi, Ethernet) to prevent C2 encryption key synchronization and network share traversal.
3. RESTORATION: Check Volume Shadow Copies and local Time Machine backups taken prior to the timestamp of infection.
4. CANARY RECOVERY: Inspect canary tripwire folder to identify the first encrypted file and locate any unencrypted backups in memory.
5. SYSTEM REBOOT: Boot into Safe Mode to remove secondary persistence runners.

WORM.name: Network Worm / Lateral Propagator
WORM.description: Self-replicating malware scanning local subnets and brute-forcing open ports (SMB, SSH, RDP) to infect neighboring machines.
remediation_playbook: 1. NETWORK ISOLATION: Immediately disconnect the host from the local LAN / Wi-Fi to stop propagation to other network nodes.
2. PROCESS TERMINATION: Kill the scanning PID and all child subprocesses.
3. FIREWALL RULE: Block inbound and outbound SMB (port 445/139) and RDP (port 3389) immediately.
4. REMOVABLE MEDIA: Disconnect all attached USB drives and network-attached storage (NAS) to prevent drive-by file replication.
5. CREDENTIAL ROTATION: Invalidate and rotate all SSH keys, Active Directory, and local administrator passwords on this machine.

SPYWARE_INFOSTEALER.name: Spyware / Infostealer / Surveillance
SPYWARE_INFOSTEALER.description: Passively captures user input, keystrokes, webcam/microphone feeds, screen recordings, and extracts browser passwords.
remediation_playbook: 1. PROCESS KILL: Terminate the background surveillance process immediately.
2. HARDWARE REVOCATION: Revoke application camera and microphone permissions in OS Privacy settings.
3. SESSION TERMINATION: Force-log out of all active web sessions and invalidate browser session cookies from a separate clean device.
4. PASSWORD & KEY ROTATION: Rotate all stored passwords, master passwords, SSH keys, and cryptocurrency wallet seeds immediately.
5. PERSISTENCE REMOVAL: Check and remove hidden LaunchAgents (`~/Library/LaunchAgents`) and Windows Registry Run keys.

AI_SANDBOX_ESCAPE.name: AI Agent Sandbox & Runtime Escape
AI_SANDBOX_ESCAPE.description: An autonomous AI agent or sandboxed container escaping containment, accessing host sockets, or spawning unauthorized host shells.
remediation_playbook: 1. CONTAINER FREEZE: Immediately pause and freeze the container/agent PID (`docker pause <id>` or `kill -STOP <PID>`).
2. UNMOUNT SOCKETS: Remove all host docker socket mounts (`/var/run/docker.sock`) and sensitive volume binds.
3. PROMPT & TOOL AUDIT: Review the AI agent's tool execution logs to identify the injected prompt or tool payload that triggered the breakout.
4. NETWORK RESTRICTION: Enforce strict egress firewall filtering on the agent container so it cannot beacon out to external C2 servers.

VIRUS.name: Binary Infector / Code Injector
VIRUS.description: Injects malicious shellcode into legitimate system executables or memory spaces to propagate within the operating system.
remediation_playbook: 1. PROCESS FREEZE: Suspend the host process and the injecting process tree.
2. INTEGRITY VERIFICATION: Run OS system file integrity checks (`sfc /scannow` on Windows, `pkgutil --verify` on macOS).
3. MEMORY SCRUB: Flush and terminate injected memory processes.
4. PERMISSION RESTORATION: Re-lock system directories and verify executable write protections.

BACKDOOR_C2.name: Backdoor / Reverse Shell / C2 Beacon
BACKDOOR_C2.description: Maintains persistent stealth access to the machine, establishing periodic command-and-control beacons and interactive shells.
remediation_playbook: 1. SEVER SHELL: Immediately kill the reverse shell PID and close associated network sockets.
2. FIREWALL DROP: Add an explicit firewall drop rule for the remote C2 IP and destination port.
3. AUDIT RUNNING SERVICES: Check all listening ports using `lsof -i -P -n` or `netstat -ano` and terminate unauthorized servers.
4. REMOVE PERSISTENCE: Check cron jobs (`crontab -l`), macOS LaunchDaemons, and Windows Task Scheduler for recurring beacons.
